## EXP06 final vs superseded turns

> Added after the first EXP06 results were seen (disclosed in the report): in the overlap protocol the first question of a correction session is superseded 400 ms after it ends, so cancelling its answer is the intended behaviour. 'Final turns' = the last turn of each session (the corrected question, plus the single-turn streamed corrections).
